objective: Investigate and correct the current-head E2E failure in Quick Chat cancellation, without changing production code or committing/pushing.

source_comparison.interpretation: The main-only and CI-merge deltas in the compared chat/cancellation paths are empty; CI exercised the same relevant source tree as this checkout.

cause_assessment.classification: CI-evidence-backed inference; not reproduced on the unmodified local baseline
cause_assessment.ci_state: DOM snapshot and screenshot show recovery pending, no composer submit control, and Resume/Stop recovery actions. The submitted Quick Chat prompt used /e2e:cancel-hold. Backend log records cancellation not acknowledged within the 3s E2E join bound and unknown_prompt_outcome recovery. The E2E profile configures an 8s mock hold and 3s cancellation join.
cause_assessment.local_baseline: Exact-title unmodified run passed (14.5s test); ordered unmodified 4-test sequence passed (47.8s). Therefore do not claim the CI failure was reproduced locally or deterministically proven.
cause_assessment.trace: No trace was included in the test-results artifact.

implementation.summary: Use an interruptible /slow 30s prompt for the Quick Chat turn, then buffer and observe the actual cancellation_pending=true WebSocket event while asserting the cancel control is disabled. Release settlement and retain follow-up composer and underlying-task-running assertions.
implementation.why: The old cancel-hold fixture intentionally outlasts the E2E cancellation join and can put this session into recovery. The normal /slow prompt acknowledges cancellation; the existing cancellation observer preserves the transient real pending state for assertion.
assertions_preserved: Quick Chat cancellation is observed as pending and the cancel control is disabled
Quick Chat settles and accepts a follow-up prompt that emits two messages
The underlying task cancel control remains visible and enabled
implementation.scope: Only apps/web/e2e/tests/chat/quick-chat-cancel-palette.spec.ts changed; quick-chat-helpers.ts and all production files are unchanged.
